source.title: Missouri DNR certified laboratories (chemical + microbiological) and DHSS SPHL private drinking water kit path
source.note_request_a_kit_php: https://health.mo.gov/living/environment/privatedrinkingwater/request-a-kit.php returned HTTP 404 on 2026-09-08; kit guidance lives on the Well Water Test Kit Information and Services page (archived).
limitations: Lab rows transcribed from Missouri DNR Certified Chemical Laboratories and Certified Microbiological Laboratories Excel downloads retrieved 8 September 2026. Only rows with State=MO and Commercial=Yes are tabulated.
Out-of-state Commercial labs on the same rosters are omitted — use the official DNR pages/Excel.
Labs with Commercial=No (including many municipal utility labs) are omitted. DNR states laboratories listed as commercial do perform analyses for hire.

Some Commercial=Yes microbiological rows have municipal utility, county health, military, or water-company names; they are kept as printed because DNR marks Commercial=Yes. Private-well acceptance at each address is unknown — call first.
DNR hub states analysis of private residences/private wells does NOT have to be done by a certified laboratory.

SPHL (cert 3 on microbiological Excel) is treated as verified for private wells based on DHSS Well Water Test Kit and SPHL bacteriological/chemical pages (kits via LPHA). Excluded from the commercial micro table to avoid double-counting.
DHSS states it does not offer testing for real estate transactions.
Official SPHL bacteriological page states a $10 handling fee (check or money order only). Cited with link; other prices omitted.
Legacy URL request-a-kit.php returned 404 on retrieval day; current kit path is Well Water Test Kit Information and Services plus LPHA directory / Qualtrics request form linked from that page.
Phone numbers normalized to (XXX) XXX-XXXX when 10 digits were present. Addresses kept as printed on DNR Excel.

verified_private_well.name: Missouri State Public Health Laboratory (via local public health agency kit)
verified_private_well.path: Contact your Local Public Health Agency (or State District Health Office) for an SPHL collection kit; SPHL analyzes private drinking-water samples for bacteria and chemical panels per DHSS.
verified_private_well.notes: DHSS Well Water Test Kit Information and Services (retrieved 8 September 2026) states SPHL offers both bacteria and chemical private drinking water testing; contact LPHA for a kit. Same page states DHSS does not offer testing for real estate transactions. SPHL bacteriological page states kits via LPHA/District offices and a $10 handling fee (check or money order only).

labs.program: Private drinking water bacteriological and chemical (via LPHA kit)
labs.source_document: DHSS Well Water Test Kit Information and Services; SPHL Private Drinking Water Bacteriological Testing; DNR microbiological certified list (Excel retrieved 2026-09-08)
labs.notes: Verified for private wells because DHSS/SPHL pages state SPHL analyzes private drinking-water samples (bacteria and chemical) when kits are obtained through local public health agencies or State District Health Offices. DHSS states it does not offer testing for real estate transactions. Official bacteriological page cites a $10 handling fee (check or money order only). Confirm kit path, holding times, and fees with your LPHA before collecting.
